title: Deductible Options and the Private Flood Compliance Aid Statement — HomeFlood Lender Services Desk
content:
For **HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies**, the per-occurrence deductible is elected from the tier's list, and the tier's form and the elected deductible together decide whether the policy can carry the private flood compliance aid statement that lenders must accept.

| Tier | Deductibles that may be elected (USD) | Lowest deductible | Deductible when none is elected | Highest deductible still carrying the compliance aid statement | Form at least as broad as the SFIP (can carry the statement) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| HomeFlood Renters | 500, 1000, 1500, 2000, 2500, 5000 | 500 | 1000 | 10000 | no |
| HomeFlood Essential | 1000, 1500, 2000, 2500, 5000, 10000 | 1000 | 2000 | 10000 | no |
| HomeFlood Standard | 1000, 1500, 2000, 2500, 5000, 10000 | 1000 | 2000 | 10000 | yes |
| HomeFlood Plus | 1000, 1500, 2000, 2500, 5000, 10000, 25000 | 1000 | 2500 | 10000 | yes |
| HomeFlood Premier | 1500, 2000, 2500, 5000, 10000, 25000, 50000 | 1500 | 5000 | 10000 | yes |
| HomeFlood Estate | 2500, 5000, 10000, 25000, 50000 | 2500 | 10000 | 10000 | yes |

## Desk notes on the table

1. The highest compliance-aid deductible is 10,000 USD on every tier. A deductible above it leaves the policy without the statement even where the tier's form qualifies.
2. On HomeFlood Renters and HomeFlood Essential the form does not qualify, so neither tier carries the statement at any deductible.
3. A deductible of exactly 10,000 USD on HomeFlood Standard, Plus, Premier or Estate is no more than the highest figure and keeps the statement; 25,000 USD does not.

| Hypothetical case | Form qualifies | Deductible at or below 10,000 USD | Statement carried |
|---|---|---|---|
| HomeFlood Plus, 5,000 USD deductible | yes | yes | yes |
| HomeFlood Plus, 25,000 USD deductible | yes | no | no |
| HomeFlood Essential, 2,000 USD deductible | no | yes | no |
